hooks.command: path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.notebook_path // empty'); case "$path" in figures/*.png|figures/*.pdf|./figures/*.png|./figures/*.pdf|*/figures/*.png|*/figures/*.pdf) echo "Blocked: $path is a generated figure. Regenerate via 'uv run python figures/generate_figures.py' instead of editing in place." >&2; exit 2 ;; paper/creative_determinant.pdf|./paper/creative_determinant.pdf|*/paper/creative_determinant.pdf) echo "Blocked: $path is a build output. Rebuild it with paper/build_paper.sh (pinned TeX Live image), copy paper/build/creative_determinant.pdf into paper/, and confirm with scripts/check_paper_artifact.py; CI requires byte identity." >&2; exit 2 ;; *paper/cd_stack.svg|*paper/cd_stack_core.pdf|*paper/cd_stack_loop.pdf|*docs/assets/cd-stack.svg) echo "Blocked: $path is rendered from paper/cd_stack.dot. Edit the source and run 'make -C paper', then rebuild the paper." >&2; exit 2 ;; esac

path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$path" in *.py) command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; uv run ruff format "$path" || { rc=$?; echo "[hook] ruff format failed for $path (exit $rc)" >&2; exit 2; }; uv run ruff check --fix "$path" || { rc=$?; echo "[hook] ruff check --fix failed for $path (exit $rc); fix and re-edit" >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac
